question: The government of India initiated the comprehensive family planning programme in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1972**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Family Planning Programme**

 
 
• The government of India initiated the comprehensive** family planning programme **in the year **1972**.
 
• **​**In **1952**, India became the first nation in the world to introduce a** national programme** for **family planning**.
 
• The **programme **has changed over the years in terms of policy and actual **programme **execution.
 
• It is currently being repositioned to meet goals for population **stabilisation **as well as reproductive** health promotion **and a decrease in **maternal**, **newborn**, and **child mortality **and **morbidity**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** National Population Policy of 2000**, **NHP**, and other policy documents (NPP: Family Welfare Goals and Objectives) serve as the foundation for the **goals**, **strategies**, and **initiatives** developed and implemented by the** Family Planning division**.
 
• **National Health Policy 2017**, and **NHM**: National Rural Health Mission) (including **ICPD**: International Conference on Population and Development, **MDG**: Millennium Development Goals, **SDG**: Sustainable Development Goals, and others).
